title: 2009 HMMT November Guts Problem 14
statement: Let \(f(x)=x^{4}+a x^{3}+b x^{2}+c x+d\) be a polynomial whose roots are all negative integers. If \(a+b+c+d=2009\), find \(d\).

solutions.text: 528 Call the roots \(-x_{1},-x_{2},-x_{3}\), and \(-x_{4}\). Then \(f(x)\) must factor as \(\left(x+x_{1}\right)\left(x+x_{2}\right)(x+\) \(\left.x_{3}\right)\left(x+x_{4}\right)\). If we evaluate \(f\) at 1 , we get \(\left(1+x_{1}\right)\left(1+x_{2}\right)\left(1+x_{3}\right)\left(1+x_{4}\right)=a+b+c+d+1=\) \(2009+1=2010\). \(2010=2 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdot 67\). \(d\) is the product of the four roots, so \(d=(-1) \cdot(-2) \cdot(-4) \cdot(-66)\).
